_comment: Sample policy wording and a small policy register for the demo. Fictional insurer 'Apex Mutual'. Gemini receives the clauses for the claim's product and decides which apply; the system uses the register to check policy dates and deductibles.

auto.name: Apex Mutual Personal Auto Policy (sample wording)

clauses.title: Collision Coverage
clauses.text: We will pay for direct and accidental loss to your covered auto caused by collision with another object or by upset of the vehicle, less the collision deductible shown in the declarations.

clauses.title: Comprehensive Coverage
clauses.text: We will pay for direct and accidental loss to your covered auto not caused by collision, including fire, theft, hail, windstorm, falling objects and glass breakage, less the comprehensive deductible shown in the declarations.

clauses.title: Deductibles
clauses.text: Each loss is subject to the deductible shown in the declarations for the coverage that applies. One deductible applies per occurrence.

clauses.title: Glass Breakage
clauses.text: Windshield and window glass breakage is paid under Comprehensive Coverage subject to the reduced glass deductible shown in the declarations. Recalibration of driver-assistance cameras required by the glass replacement is included.

clauses.title: Reasonable Repair Costs
clauses.text: We will pay no more than the reasonable cost to repair or replace the damaged property with property of like kind and quality, at labor rates prevailing in the area where repairs are made. We do not pay for repair or replacement of parts that were not damaged in the loss.

clauses.title: Commercial Use and Rideshare Exclusion
clauses.text: We do not provide coverage for any vehicle while it is being used to carry persons or property for a fee, including while the driver is logged into a transportation network company (rideshare) application, unless the Rideshare Endorsement RS-99 is shown in the declarations.

clauses.title: Duties After a Loss
clauses.text: You must promptly report the loss, provide photographs and repair estimates, allow us to inspect the damaged vehicle before repairs begin, and cooperate with our investigation.

clauses.title: Fraud and Misrepresentation
clauses.text: We do not provide coverage for any person who has intentionally concealed or misrepresented a material fact, engaged in fraudulent conduct, or made false statements in connection with a claim under this policy.

home.name: Apex Mutual Homeowners HO-3 Policy (sample wording)

clauses.title: Sudden and Accidental Discharge of Water
clauses.text: We cover direct physical loss caused by the sudden and accidental discharge of water or steam from within a plumbing, heating or air-conditioning system or household appliance, including the cost of tearing out and replacing the part of the building needed to repair the system.

clauses.title: Continuous Seepage Exclusion
clauses.text: We do not cover loss caused by continuous or repeated seepage or leakage of water over a period of 14 days or more, or by wear and tear, deterioration, mold or rot resulting from it.

clauses.title: Duty to Mitigate
clauses.text: After a loss you must take reasonable steps to protect the property from further damage, such as stopping the flow of water and arranging drying. Reasonable costs of these emergency measures are covered.

clauses.title: Reasonable Repair Costs
clauses.text: We will pay the reasonable cost to repair or replace the damaged part of the dwelling with materials of like kind and quality, at prevailing local rates.

clauses.title: Deductible
clauses.text: Each covered loss is subject to the all-perils deductible shown in the declarations.

clauses.title: Fraud and Misrepresentation
clauses.text: We do not provide coverage for any insured who has intentionally concealed or misrepresented a material fact, engaged in fraudulent conduct, or made false statements in connection with a claim under this policy.
